title: Cover canonical MCP list fallback for unsafe native ids and satellite list-to-send flow
outcome: Tests distinguish unsafe native-id fallback from display-name handling and cover the satellite MCP directory list-to-send contract.
acceptance: A participant with native id outside copyable HostNative syntax advertises its canonical sessionId as name and list-copy-send appends to that exact principal.
A satellite-side MCP list/remote-target send control uses existing authenticated transport and asserts the retained destination without inventing authority.
